name: Legions of Morgul
game_text:
To play, spot 2 <culture>Sauron</culture> Orcs and add up to 3 threats.
Each time a companion is about to be killed, you may remove a threat to make all minions <keyword>fierce</keyword> until the regroup phase.
Discard this condition and remove 3 threats at the start of the regroup phase.
